function.name: concert_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby concerts based on specific criteria like genre and availability of parking. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find all classical concerts next Friday near Berlin and Paris, only those with parking. We need to call the function concert_find_nearby twice: one for Berlin, one for Paris. The date: next Friday. We need to compute next Friday's date. Today is 2026-11-03. Let's calculate next Friday. 2026-11-03 is a Thursday? Let's check: 2026-11-03. We can approximate: 2026-11-01 is a Tuesday? Actually let's quickly compute: 2026-01-01 is a Monday? Wait, we can use known reference: 2023-01-01 was a Sunday. 2026-01-01 would be 3 years later. 2023-01-01 Sunday. 2024-01-01 is a Monday (2024 is leap year). 2025-01-01 is Wednesday? Wait, let's do systematically: 2023-01-01 Sunday. 2024-01-01 Monday. 2025-01-01 Wednesday? Actually 2024 has 366 days, so 2025-01-01 is Wednesday? 2024-01-01 Monday + 366 mod 7 = 2 days shift -> Wednesday. 2026-01-01 is Thursday? 2025 has 365 days, shift 1 day -> Thursday. So 2026-01-01 is Thursday. Then 2026-11-03 is 10 months and 2 days after Jan 1. 2026-01-01 Thursday. Add 10 months: 2026-11-01 is? Let's count days: Jan 31 days, Feb 28 (2026 not leap), Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31. Sum up to Oct 31: 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31 = 304 days. So Jan 1 + 304 days = Oct 31. Jan 1 Thursday + 304 mod 7 = 304 mod 7 = 304 - 42*7=304-294=10; 10 mod 7 = 3. So shift 3 days: Thursday + 3 = Sunday. So Oct 31 is Sunday. Then Oct 31 + 3 days = Nov 3. So Nov 3 is Wednesday? Wait, Oct 31 Sunday + 3 days = Nov 3 Wednesday. So 2026-11-03 is Wednesday. Next Friday from Wednesday is two days later: 2026-11-05. So date is 2026-11-05.

We need to call function with location "Berlin", date "2026-11-05", genre "Classical", amenities "Parking". Also for "Paris".

We should pass amenities as array or string? The function signature says amenities?: "Parking" | "Food and Beverages" | "VIP Seating" | "Disability Access"[], default: ["Parking"]. It seems amenities can be an array of strings. We'll pass ["Parking"].

We'll call function twice.
